# Create a sandboxed tool (tools.create)

## categories

[
  "code",
  "agent-tools"
]

## demonstrations

  {
    "deterministic": false,

## description

Give a workspace .py file defining run(arguments) and returning a JSON object. Module-level code and the function execute only in the container sandbox through python.run, five seconds per call. Do not print extra stdout. Examples must match exactly before registration. Source bytes are pinned: edits or deletion of the source file do not change the registered tool. Choose a new agent.<slug> id to create an improved tool. Use capabilities.search/describe/demonstrate/invoke to find and use it later. Input/output schemas support explicit single types, object properties/required/additionalProperties=false, bounded array items/minItems/maxItems <=1024, bounded strings minLength/maxLength <=16000, numeric minimum/maximum, enum <=64 and description. No references, patterns or schema compositions. Schemas: <=16000 bytes, depth <=8, <=128 nodes. Calls and example data: <=16000 JSON bytes. Source: <=32000 UTF-8 bytes. At most sixteen tools per run. Registration requires the experiment agent_created_tools flag. Both the new tool and python.run must be permitted; no other permissions can be requested. Example executions can change your workspace, even if registration fails.

  {

    "recovery": "Fix the source or definition and retry. Use a new id to improve an accepted tool.",
    "symptom": "A recorded error; no registration. Earlier example side effects remain."
  }
]

## limitations

]
